title: Answer Context Knowledge Source QA
principle: Knowledge used by an answer should produce safe source metadata that can focus exact local documents or collections without storing document text in receipts.
public_repo_rule: Knowledge-use receipts store only document IDs, collection IDs, source labels and counts. Raw prompts, raw responses, snippets, uploaded document text and provider secrets stay out of receipt and highlight metadata.

scenarios.expected: The runtime snapshots metadata-only knowledge-use IDs for local and protected backend knowledge context into the next answer context.
Answer receipts carry knowledge_use_ids, knowledge_use_count and knowledge_sources into drill-down highlights.
Knowledge drill-downs set data-receipt-filter-knowledge-ids so local documents or collections can be marked as used in the selected answer.
Knowledge source receipts and reports remain metadata-only and never publish snippets, uploaded text, raw prompts, raw responses or provider secrets.
